selection: Five largest consistency-minus-V6 human log-loss increases in origin-error-anatomy-v1.json, selected before the full-text review.
read_scope: All five scored texts in full and their stored source/evidence metadata, read from the frozen corpus on the Studio. No live historical archive audit was performed in this review.

observations: The prose attributes allegations to government and law-enforcement sources and describes charges, objectives and communication methods.
The opening refers to previously identified arrested people. The final paragraph explains a bullet list that is absent from the scored extract.

The extract is readable news prose with incomplete surrounding context. Missing context is a source-view concern; it does not by itself establish an incorrect origin label or explain the detector error.
A short narrative synopsis follows an attack survivor and then introduces a second character before describing the eventual convergence.
The closing evaluates the conclusion for its emotional effect without disclosing it. I read this as promotional synopsis register.
Formulaic promotional phrasing can occur in historical human prose; its presence does not justify relabeling this record.
The narrative introduces a graduate student, a family house and discoveries that connect her to historical witch trials.
Suspenseful language and promises of hidden significance give it a promotional register.
The final comparison uses then where than is expected and includes spacing before the period. These are visible source defects, not proof of human authorship or a demonstrated cause of the score.
A detailed plot account follows academic pressure, hospitalization, relationships, recovery and the narrator's final intentions.
It repeatedly names the protagonist and includes appositive descriptions, subordinate clauses and lists.
Unlike the two earlier promotional summaries, it discloses the resolution. The four selected summaries should not all be assigned an identical promotional subtype.
The synopsis distinguishes two escaped creatures, introduces a second human protagonist and enumerates several sources of danger.
Participant descriptions use appositives and relative clauses; the final sentence combines multiple pursuit relationships.
It is intelligible narrative prose. This reading alone cannot determine which lexical or grammatical choices affected the score.

limits: Adaptive inspection of known Test examples. Historical provenance is weak human supervision. Stored book metadata does not identify the summary writer. No new origin gold label, parse-accuracy assessment, fresh confirmation, training admission or causal feature claim follows.
